The Shopify Payments service ("Shopify Payments" or the "Payments Services") is Shopify's integrated payments solution that arranges for the financial services you need to accept payments
The Payout balance amount represents the funds that have been captured but not yet added to a scheduled payout, not including reserved funds.
Reserved funds: Money that's temporarily held and that can't be accessed until the reserve period ends.
Your total balance is the sum of your Payout balance and Reserved funds amounts.
A reserve is a temporary hold on a portion, in some cases a full amount, of transactions processed through Shopify Payments for a specified period.
Transactions marked as Pending are for sales that you've made, but that haven't been added to a payout and sent to your bank account yet.
Settlement time refers to the amount of time between when a customer's payment is captured and those funds are available to be paid out to your bank account.
Your payout schedule determines when funds from sales are transferred to your bank account.

Acquirer — means a financial institution that is registered with the applicable Payment Networks to acquire payment card transactions and that sponsors a Shopify entity's registration as a Payment Facilitator (or equivalent designation) with those Payment Networks.

Payment Facilitator — an entity registered with the Payment Networks under an Acquirer's sponsorship and in accordance with the Payment Network Rules that contracts with Merchants to facilitate the Merchant's acceptance of payment transactions.
Settlement of your valid Transactions, net of fees, refunds, chargebacks, reserves, and other amounts owed, will be paid to your Payout Account.
